components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and
            brackets and an optional leading '+' with country code; stored and
            returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). When no
            country code is given, '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Acknowledgement that this owner deliberately shares a household with an
            existing owner. When true, the create request is allowed even though
            another owner has the same last name and address; otherwise such a
            request is rejected as a conflict. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city via the pinned city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a global
                4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned when the owner is created.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the registration date's year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners that deliberately share a household
                (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created with
                'sharesHousehold' true; the joining owner and the existing household
                members all carry the same value. Absent for owners not in a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'H-3F9A1C2B4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key: the canonical telephone, the
                lower-cased email (empty when absent) and the household id (empty when the
                owner is in no shared household), joined by '|'. A create request is rejected
                as a conflict only when its whole identity key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|H-3F9A1C2B4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created. Zero when the
                name was new.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 fixed when the owner was
                created. It starts at 1, gains 1 when an email address is present, and gains 1
                when the owner has a unique name (namesakeCount is zero), capped at 3. Level 4 is
                reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been registered on this owner's
                (business-day-adjusted) registration date at the moment it was created;
                false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from their details: 'EMAIL'
                when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented an optional, region-validated `postcode` field for owners, following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions.

**Validation logic (single responsibility, reused existing code):**
- `util/RegionPostcodes.java` — new pinned region→range table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) with `allows(region, postcode)`; a region with no known range is permissive. Mirrors the existing `CityRegion` util rather than duplicating city knowledge.
- `rest/function/owner/ValidatePostcode.java` — a small step that validates **only when present**: requires 4 digits, then derives the region via the existing `CityRegion.of(city)` and checks the range via `RegionPostcodes.allows(...)`. Missing/blank postcode is accepted, keeping the contract backward-compatible.
- `escalation/InvalidPostcodeException.java` + `InvalidPostcodeExceptionHandler.java` + escalation YAML — a checked exception handled as 400, matching the existing single-field-error pattern (`InvalidTelephoneLengthException`).

**Storage & return:**
- Added `postcode` to `OwnerFields` in `openapi.yml` (flows into the generated `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto`), and a `postcode` column/field on the `Owner` entity — so MapStruct maps it both ways automatically (no mapper change). Added the column to all four `schema.sql` files (existing inserts use explicit column lists, so seed data is unaffected).
- `ApplyOwner` now also copies postcode, so PUT updates persist it.

**Wiring:**
- Inserted a `validatePostcode` step into `owners.POST.yml` (after required-field validation) and the `owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml` pipeline (after body validation, before load) — so an invalid postcode is a 400 regardless of endpoint.
